title: A tests.py run a check makes still records its test.run row in the clone's spool
goal: The operator changed ST-3p74zj4k's provisional gate testrows to keep in the SP-owbgisoj review: since bl_base.run_check isolates each check's query log home, the test.run ops row of a tests.py run that done, land or precheck makes lands in the throwaway home and the weekly digest's ops block (ql_report.ops_lines) never sees it. run_check names the clone's real query log home in an environment variable, tests.py writes its test.run row there when it is set, and every other capture of the check stays isolated; kb/_self/maintaining.md, tools.md and backlog.md say so.

run: import glob,sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_base;n=lambda:sum(open(p,encoding="utf-8").read().count("test.run") for p in glob.glob("_cache/querylog/spool/*.jsonl"));a=n();ok,c,o=bl_base.run_check(".",{"run":["python3","_tools/tests.py","-k","test_backlog_check_refuses_programs_outside_the_allowlist"]});b=n();print("test.run rows in the clone spool before/after a check:",a,b,ok);sys.exit(0 if ok and b>a else 1)
